en: Rūpāvacaraduka, Kusalattika (The Couplets on the Fine-Material Sphere, The Triplet on the Wholesome)
Dependent on a wholesome dhamma of the fine-material sphere, a non-material and unwholesome dhamma arises by way of root condition.
Dependent on a non-material wholesome dhamma, a non-material unwholesome dhamma arises by way of root condition. There are two [instances] for root;
... pe ... there are two for non-disappearance.

Dependent on a non-material unwholesome state, a non-material non-unwholesome state arises by way of root condition. Under root condition there is one; ... pe ... under non-disappearance condition there is one. (The indeterminate root has two conditions.)
